trial_name.text: HPST99-CUS01 (North American pivotal Phase III trial)

citations.quote: For the purpose of obtaining the indication of *H. pylori* eradication, one North American Phase III trial (HPST99-CUS01) is considered pivotal.

design.text: Multi-center, randomized, parallel group, open-label (investigator blinded), active-controlled study comparing 10-day Helicide capsules plus omeprazole (OBMT) versus omeprazole, amoxicillin, and clarithromycin (OAC)

citations.quote: This is a multi-center, randomized, parallel group, open-label (investigator blinded) Phase III study of the efficacy and safety of 10-day therapy of Helicide capsules given with omeprazole (OBMT) compared to the FDA-approved regimen of omeprazole, amoxicillin and clarithromycin (OAC) in the eradication of *H. pylori*.

population.text: Helicobacter pylori positive patients with current duodenal ulcer or a history of duodenal ulcer disease, in the United States and Canada

citations.quote: An open-label, parallel group, active-controlled, multicenter study in *Helicobacter pylori* positive patients with current duodenal ulcer or a history of duodenal ulcer disease was conducted in the United States and Canada.

endpoint.text: H. pylori eradication rate, defined as two negative 13C-urea breath tests performed at 4 and 8 weeks post-therapy

citations.quote: *H. pylori* eradication rates, defined as two negative 13C-urea breath tests performed at 4 and 8 weeks post-therapy are shown in Table 4 for OBMT and OAC.

n.text: 299 patients received study therapy (147 OBMT and 152 OAC)

citations.quote: A total of 299 patients received study therapy (147 OBMT and 152 OAC). The Modified Intent-to-Treat (MITT) population was comprised of 275 patients (138 OBMT and 137 OAC) and there were 244 patients in the Per Protocol (PP) population (120 OBMT and 124 OAC).

result.text: Per-Protocol eradication: OBMT 92.5% [87.8, 97.2] (n=120) vs OAC 85.7% [76.9, 91.8] (n=126), difference 6.8 [-0.9, 14.5]; Modified Intent-to-Treat: OBMT 87.7% [82.2, 93.2] (n=138) vs OAC 83.2% [77.0, 89.5] (n=137), difference 4.5 [-3.9, 12.8] — demonstrating non-inferiority (lower bounds of -3.9% MITT and -0.9% PP are above the non-inferiority margin of -15%)

citations.quote: This is a well conducted, randomized, active-controlled clinical trial that demonstrated the non-inferiority of OBMT versus OAC when given for 10 days. The lower bound of the 95% confidence intervals for the difference in eradication rates for the OBMT minus OAC groups are -3.9% and -0.9% for the MITT and PP analyses, respectively. Therefore, the confidence intervals are above a non-inferiority margin of -15% and provide evidence of the efficacy of Helizide plus omeprazole therapy (OBMT) in the treatment of *H. pylori* infection.

indication.text: PYLERA capsules, in combination with omeprazole, are indicated for the treatment of patients with Helicobacter pylori infection and duodenal ulcer disease (active or history of within the past 5 years) to eradicate H. pylori

citations.quote: PYLERA™ capsules (bismuth subcitrate potassium, metronidazole, and tetracycline hydrochloride), in combination with omeprazole are indicated for the treatment of patients with *Helicobacter pylori* infection and duodenal ulcer disease (active or history of within the past 5 years) to eradicate *H. pylori*.
